description: B20 (S2, ADR-0011) dsl-conformance-max witness: the 'shipping' bounded context. Imports 'billing' (D3) and references its concept via the qualified name billing::Invoice (D1) in a declared query -- the corpus witness for check-dsl-coverage.py's 'contexts' feature. S4 (roadmap B27) extends this same fixture with the groupBy join corpus witness: DeliveryAttempt.shipment is a SAME-CONTEXT reference (Shipment also lives in 'shipping'); Shipment.invoice is a CROSS-CONTEXT reference into the imported 'billing' context -- one fixture exercising both join shapes check-dsl-coverage.py's query.groupBy.join / query.groupBy.join.crossContext features require. S8 W1.1 (roadmap deferred item #1) extends it again with a two-hop chain through the SAME two reference fields (shipment then invoice) -- the corpus witness for check-dsl-coverage.py's query.groupBy.join.multiHop feature. R4.3 lockstep fix (Roadmap Wave 1 gap closure): RecentFailedOrUpsDeliveryAttempts below is the corpus witness for the query predicate v2 grammar (query.where.v2) -- an OR-group, a reference-path join reusing this same shipment.carrier field, and a date comparison in one where, the exact combination PackValidation#validateQueryWhereCompiles now accepts and DefaultProcedureExecutor#runQuery now executes (compileToConceptQueryFilters).

metadata.purpose: Coverage for query.where.v2 (R4.3 lockstep fix): an OR-group whose first AND-clause crosses a reference-path join (shipment.carrier) plus a date comparison, combined with a second, plain-field OR branch -- the exact shape PackValidation#validateQueryWhereCompiles now validates and DefaultProcedureExecutor#runQuery now executes end-to-end via ConceptQueryPredicateCompiler#compileToConceptQueryFilters.
